chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Mansur ibn al-Abbas, from Ibn Mayyah, from his father, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'The one who seeks leadership is destroyed.'
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about seeking leadership?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies 'al-ri'asah' (leadership/preeminence) as a specific spiritual peril when pursued for self-aggrandizement rather than service, a concept central to Shia ethical theology. This warning underscores the danger of ego-driven ambition, contrasting it with the Shia ideal of leadership (imamah) as a divine trust (amanah) requiring humility and selflessness. The hadith serves as a critical reminder that the intent behind seeking authority determines one's ultimate spiritual fate.
